display_long_description:
**First Time in VR:** Introducing 3D Google Street View
# Google Earth, now with the highest 3D quality on the market
- The ever-growing coverage includes nearly **all recognizable cities on Earth in 3D**
- WorldLens delivers superior 3D quality, enhanced by the AI-powered ’Upscale 3D Imagery’ feature
# Street View
- Navigate all **Google** and **Community** imagery on Earth, supporting 8k fidelity at maximum screen resolution
- Travel across timelines with the new Time Travel feature
# Multiplayer
- Explore with friends!
# World AI can
- Naturally communicate in your own language
- Visualize your virtual surroundings and location for intelligent responses
- Access real-time information
- Be your travel guide
- Automate tours
- ... + Much more
# Realistic Graphics
- True-to-life lighting based on the adjustable day/night cycle
- Lifelike adaptive haze
# 3D Quality
- Dynamic levels of detail enable fine detail, delivering unlimited render distance and smooth performance
# Comfort Settings
- Comfort Options (Snap Turning, Movement Vignette) preventing motion sickness
- Input Modes (Customizable Movement Controls)
# Easy Navigation
- Quick Maps view: auto/manual altitude-based zoom, paired with compass for orientation
- Integrated full Google Maps experience
# Hand Tracking Support
- Fly by simply pointing your index finger
- Rotate with an intuitive "steering" gesture

—

WorldLens is committed to ensuring the best possible travel experience.
Bon voyage! 🌍
